fact.thing: days bitcoin took to get back to its old high after the 2018 crash
fact.claim: Bitcoin has dropped by more than half several times. The slowest recovery came after the 2018 crash, when it took over 1,000 days to reach its old high again, and the same CryptoSlate table puts the 2022 recovery at 469 days. Today bitcoin trades about 39.8% below its all-time high of $126,080, according to CoinGecko's snapshot. Past recoveries do not promise future ones, and anyone who sold at the bottom locked in the loss.
